overview: Frosted glass should prioritize controlled transparency, soft shell breakup, and roughness variation over emissive or heavy color tint.
common_failure_modes: strong emissive making it look magical instead of glass
uniform roughness with no readability difference across the surface
capture_review_checklist: Front shot keeps the silhouette readable.
Three-quarter shot shows surface breakup without turning milky white.
Grazing shot has soft edge polish rather than blown-out highlights.
